newsitem.title: CHINA: China to set up third state oil company.
newsitem.headline: China to set up third state oil company.

text.p: China's Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources will set up the country's third state oil company this month, a ministry offical said on Friday.
The Xinxing Oil Ltd Co would be controlled by the minerals ministry and would engage in oil exploration and exploitation, a ministry official told Reuters by telephone.
The new company would have assets worth 3.0 billion yuan ($360 million), the official said.
"We got approval last December from the State Council to set up the company," he said, adding that the ministry had been preparing to launch the new firm for two years.
"Our company's scale is smaller than the other two (state oil companies)," he said but declined to give details of output target for 1997.
China's other two state oil companies, the China National Petroleum Corp and the China National Offshore Oil Corp, were both under the direct control of the State Council, China's cabinet, he said.
The company had not yet decided on an official English name, he said, adding that a formal announcement on its launch would be made later this month.
